name: agent-pack
description: Deterministic Agent-extension capability management for configured workspaces.

interface.shortDescription: 盘点 / 校验 / 安装 / 同步 / 迁移 Agent Plugin、Skill 与 MCP
interface.longDescription: 确定性的 Agent 扩展能力管理器：在项目、插件目录与 Codex / Cursor 客户端之间 inventory / doctor / bootstrap / sync / transfer / reconcile。所有写操作默认 dry-run，重名与含密钥的 MCP 条目失败关闭。项目生命周期（Task/Case/路由/验证/Git）由 project-orchestrator 承担，不在本包内。
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $agent-pack to inventory this project's Agent Plugins, Skills, and MCP servers and report drift against the declared contract.
